# Vendored Heroes protocol corpus

This directory contains the runtime-only generated protocol corpus from
`GaryIrick/heroprotocol` version 2.0.2 at commit
`9cc5bccc93a8872b79a877d9f0301917effa5576`.

The snapshot was generated on 2025-08-31 and contains 372 exact build modules,
from build 29406 through build 94786. The upstream install script, CLI tools,
examples, logging, and sample replays are intentionally excluded. Runtime
protocol discovery is local and never downloads or regenerates files.

`lib/long.js` is the upstream `long` 3.2.0 runtime dependency used by this
snapshot. Its Apache-2.0 terms are in `LONG-LICENSE`; the heroprotocol and
Blizzard notices are in `LICENSE`.
